Subject: Request: adjust demo around CedarBridge field conference + personal holiday

Hi Tessa —

Thanks for scheduling the walkthrough. Quick heads up: our team will be on the road for the CedarBridge Field Conference May 24–26 (we’ll be at booth C12), and I have a family trip immediately after (May 27–31). Between the booth duties and travel, it’s going to be hard for the whole buying committee to sit through a full 90‑minute demo that week.

Options that would work for us:
- Move to an earlier day (ideally May 21–23) for the full session, or
- Do a short 20–30 minute in‑person kickoff during the conference (we can pull decision makers for a quick run), then receive a recorded deep‑dive to watch later, plus a follow‑up live Q&A after the holiday.

If you have a suggested agenda for a condensed in‑person kickoff, please send it over and we can confirm who will be able to attend at the conference. Also looping in Emily (ops) in case procurement wants to be added to the follow‑up thread.

Thanks,
Sam

Hi Sam —

Totally understand — that travel + booth schedule is a tough window. Thanks for the clear options. We can absolutely split this to make it low‑friction for your team:

Proposal (concise):
1) In‑person kickoff at the conference: 30 minutes max, focused on high‑level outcomes and where Redwood fits. Proposed slot: May 24 at 9:30 AM at booth C12.
2) Recorded deep‑dive: I’ll have our product engineer record a 40–45 minute walkthrough that covers integration patterns, routing/policy examples, and quantization/cost profiles. We’ll share the recording and a short companion notes doc.
3) Live Q&A: 60 minute office hours two weeks after the conference (proposed June 2 or June 3) for technical and procurement questions.

I attached a one‑page demo agenda and a draft mutual action plan (MAP) so you can see the milestones we usually align on. If the committee prefers entirely asynchronous, we can skip the booth slot and send the recording now — but the booth kickoff tends to be effective to get executive buy‑in when people are on site.

I’m cc’ing Karthik to confirm coverage for the recorded deep‑dive and to pick the best office‑hours times.
